title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
department: Ministry of Jal Shakti and Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, in coordination with the Government of Karnataka

scheme_details.description: A national irrigation and water-management programme intended to expand irrigation coverage, improve on-farm water-use efficiency and promote sustainable water conservation.
eligibility: Farmers applying under an eligible component implemented in Karnataka
Farmers cultivating land that meets the relevant component requirements
Applicants meeting the applicable district, crop and irrigation-system guidelines
Farmer groups and other institutions where permitted under specific components
farmer_category: Farmer groups and water-user associations where eligible

money_benefits.subsidy: Financial assistance for eligible irrigation and water-management activities under the relevant PMKSY component. Rates depend on component, beneficiary category and current state guidelines.
money_benefits.micro_irrigation_support: Assistance for eligible drip and sprinkler irrigation systems under the Per Drop More Crop component.
money_benefits.watershed_support: Support for eligible watershed development, soil and moisture conservation and water-harvesting activities under the relevant component.

scheme_details.water_irrigation_support: Eligible activities may include drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, improved on-farm water-use efficiency, watershed development, water harvesting and irrigation infrastructure, depending on the PMKSY component.
documents_required: Aadhaar or other accepted identity proof
Farmer registration or Farmer ID, where required
Additional documents required by the implementing department
application_process: Identify the relevant PMKSY component, such as Per Drop More Crop or watershed development.
Visit the Karnataka Agriculture Department portal or nearest Raita Samparka Kendra.
Ask whether the relevant component is open to individual farmer applications in the district.
Obtain the current application form and subsidy guidelines.
Submit the requested farmer, land, bank and irrigation-system details.
Complete the required field verification or technical assessment.
Wait for approval and follow the department's instructions before purchasing or installing eligible equipment.
Submit installation or completion evidence where required for subsidy release.
benefits: More efficient use of irrigation water
Support for drip and sprinkler irrigation
Support for water harvesting and watershed development
Potential reduction in irrigation-related input costs
Improved agricultural productivity through efficient water management
scheme_details.implemented_by: Government of India and Government of Karnataka through the relevant implementing departments and agencies
target_beneficiaries: Farmer groups and water-user associations where eligible
components: Repair, Renovation and Restoration of Water Bodies
Command Area Development and Water Management

data_source.notes: PMKSY is a central scheme implemented through multiple components and departments. Eligibility, subsidy rates, required documents and application procedures must be verified against the applicable Karnataka component guidelines.
